scope: Fixed-network arithmetic tied to source and selected MPNs; no BQ25798 loop or silicon simulation.
usb_note: Not proof of 100 mA USB pre-enumeration compliance. Radio/charge stay off; input current and inrush need measurement.

cold.excludes: NTC resistance/B tolerance, self-heating and mounting lag

warm_suspend_40c.excludes: NTC resistance/B tolerance, self-heating and mounting lag

hard_hot.excludes: NTC resistance/B tolerance, self-heating and mounting lag

charge_gpio_contract: Active LOW, PNP inversion, external pullup; absent 3V3 leaves NFET gate pulled down.
release_gates: USB source entitlement, power-off I2C isolation, inrush and reset/detach current-limit handling are external and unfinished.
PNP/NFET default-off topology reviewed; no worst-case full-temperature leakage/startup bench proof.
Charger thermistor tolerance, placement and thermal lag; independent MAX17320 protection profile unfinished.
Charge target 12.45 V is proposed; applying the 12.6 V accuracy test-point to it is a planning assumption.
Ceramic DC-bias capacitance, converter stability, layout parasitics and thermal behavior not validated.
Protected carrier and regenerative clamp are separate unfinished blocks.
Standalone PCB is unrouted without fabrication outline; imported footprint geometry is not qualified.
